YouTube Shorts Direct Upload Data API v3

Complete step-by-step configuration guide to create Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Web Client credentials and connect your YouTube channel.

1

Create or Select a Google Cloud Project

Google Cloud organizes all API permissions and client keys inside cloud projects.

  1. Sign in to Google Cloud Console → New Project.
  2. Enter a Project name (e.g. Fivestar Shorts Publisher) and leave the Organization as No organization.
  3. Click Create and wait a few seconds for the project to provision.
  4. Make sure your newly created project is selected in the top project dropdown bar.
2

Enable the YouTube Data API v3

You must enable the YouTube Data API v3 on your project so Google permits video uploads.

  1. Open the YouTube Data API v3 in API Library.
  2. Verify that your project from Step 1 is selected at the top.
  3. Click the blue Enable button. Once enabled, you will be redirected to the API dashboard.
3

Configure the OAuth Consent Screen & Add Test Users

Before creating credentials, Google requires configuring an OAuth Consent Screen and declaring authorized Test Users.

  1. Go to APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen.
  2. Select External as the User Type, then click Create.
  3. Fill in the required fields:
    • App name: Fivestar (or your channel name)
    • User support email: Select your Google email address
    • Developer contact information: Enter your email address
  4. Click Save and Continue through the Scopes page (no custom scopes needed).
  5. On the Test users screen, click + Add Users and enter the exact Google email address associated with your YouTube channel.
  6. Click Add, then click Save and Continue.
Important (Avoid "App Not Verified" Block): If you do not add your channel's Google email under Test users, Google will block your sign-in with a 403 access_denied error because your personal OAuth app is in Testing mode.
4

Create OAuth 2.0 Web Client Credentials

Now generate your Client ID and Client Secret with the local Fivestar redirect URI.

  1. Go to APIs & Services → Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth client ID.
  2. In the Application type dropdown, select Web application.
  3. Set the Name to Fivestar Local Client.
  4. Scroll down to Authorized redirect URIs, click + Add URI, and paste the exact URI below:
http://127.0.0.1:8765/oauth/youtube/callback
  1. Click Create. A modal will pop up displaying your Client ID and Client Secret.
  2. Copy both values into your clipboard or keep the tab open for Step 5.
5

Fill In Fivestar Settings & Connect Channel

Open Fivestar Settings (⚙️) in the top right corner and paste your credentials:

Setting Field Status Value from Google Cloud
YouTube OAuth Client ID Required The long string ending in .apps.googleusercontent.com copied from Step 4.
YouTube OAuth Client Secret Required The secret string starting with GOCSPX-... copied from Step 4.
Authorized redirect URI Pre-filled Displays http://127.0.0.1:8765/oauth/youtube/callback for reference.

Click Connect YouTube channel. A Google popup will open: select your channel account, click Continue through the testing warning, and approve permissions. Once complete, your channel name and handle will link automatically!

6

Quick Troubleshooting

  • "Access blocked: This app has not been verified" (403): You must add your Google email address under Test users in Step 3 (OAuth consent screen).
  • "Redirect URI mismatch" (400): Verify that the redirect URI in Google Cloud Console is exactly http://127.0.0.1:8765/oauth/youtube/callback. Make sure it uses 127.0.0.1 and not localhost, and has no trailing slash.
  • YouTube API Daily Quota: Google provides a free default quota of 10,000 units/day. Video uploads consume 1,600 units each (approximately 6 Shorts uploads per day on the free tier).
